facts.fact: Kevin 出院——脸仍肿；「不是你的错——你一个人也干得不错」。
facts.anchor: he’d been cleared to be discharged

facts.fact: Kevin 摸她的手——她 flinch 逃开；他道歉「忘了」。
facts.anchor: She flinched at the contact, pulling away reflexively

facts.fact: 玻璃倒影：一瞬间看见 Leonard 盯回来——脑震荡幻觉。
facts.anchor: she saw Leonard Whitaker staring back.

facts.fact: Patricia 哲学：我们是谁就是谁——改不了；做我们做的。
facts.anchor: We are who we are. There’s no changing it. We just do what we do.

facts.fact: 离镇：一段渐淡的记忆——加入其他记忆里。
facts.anchor: A fading memory to join the others.
